يجتنون (form VIII)
# يَجْتَنُونَ (yajtanūna) /jad͡ʒ.ta.nuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِجْتَنَى (ijtanā)
# يُجْتَنَوْنَ (yujtanawna) /jud͡ʒ.ta.naw.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِجْتَنَى (ijtanā)
